displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that irreducibility is warranted only if indispensable first-person, normative, and agentive facts cannot be captured by any complete realization account, not merely because microphysical vocabulary omits them.

novelty.explanation: This narrows the pro conclusion and directly repairs the invalid transition from explanatory nonreplacement to metaphysical addition.

premises.text: Any adequate account must explain why there is a determinate first-person perspective, not only why a system reports, discriminates, integrates, and acts upon information.

novelty.explanation: This develops the experiential remainder while directly incorporating the functional interface response.

premises.text: Systematic brain dependence is compatible with production, constitution, filtering, or realization, so metaphysical conclusions require evidence that discriminates among those relations.

novelty.explanation: This replaces the unsupported access assertion with a comparative underdetermination argument.

premises.text: Normative reasons purport to justify conduct, and a complete theory must explain their authority as well as the causal history through which agents acquire moral practices.

novelty.explanation: This refines the value dispute by separating justificatory authority from historical construction.

premises.text: A freedom theory must explain an agent's ownership of deliberation and control, while avoiding both antecedent compulsion and an uncontrolled random selection among outcomes.

novelty.explanation: This incorporates the randomness objection and replaces bare alternative possibilities with an ownership burden.

premises.text: Explanatory pluralism alone does not decide ontology; the decisive question is whether realization relations preserve every causal, experiential, and normative feature without remainder.

novelty.explanation: This accepts legitimate levels of explanation while identifying the remaining phenomenon-specific test.

conclusion.text: Therefore, a limited case for irreducibility remains reasonable where a specified experiential, normative, or agentive feature survives the strongest available realization account, although no blanket rejection of naturalistic explanation follows.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately narrows the live pro case to demonstrated explanatory remainders.

newArguments.title: Contrastive realization test
newArguments.text: A stronger pro methodology would compare rival realization theories using contrastive cases. If two systems share every proposed functional, behavioral, computational, and relational property, the pro side should ask whether the theories nevertheless permit a difference in experience, normative authority, or ownership. If they do, the realization base is incomplete by the theory's own lights; if they do not, the pro side can demand an explanation of why the identity is necessary rather than stipulated. This test converts a general intuition about irreducibility into a focused burden for competing accounts.

novelty.explanation: This is a new methodological argument using contrastive theory testing rather than repeating any participant's live claim.

newArguments.title: Normative error constraint
newArguments.text: A naturalized value account must explain not only agreement and improvement within practices but also the possibility that an entire settled practice is unjust. The pro side can argue that practice-independent standards earn explanatory work when they make systematic moral error intelligible without reducing error to inconsistency with another local convention. This does not establish a supernatural source of value; it instead places a precise adequacy constraint on constructivist theories and leaves open several realist ontologies compatible with the limited irreducibility thesis.

novelty.explanation: This develops the value exchange into a whole-practice error test while keeping the conclusion proportionate.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that materially realized organization can explain persons when it accounts for experience-related capacities, diachronic selfhood, purpose, normativity, and responsible control at their appropriate levels without positing causally idle additions.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens naturalism while avoiding the unsupported claim that dependence alone settles every ontological question.

premises.text: Neural interventions systematically alter awareness, memory, personality, and control, making brain realization the evidential default while leaving metaphysical conclusions defeasible.

novelty.explanation: This states a calibrated evidential inference rather than treating neural dependence as conclusive constitution.

premises.text: An evolved self-model can integrate perception, memory, prediction, and action without a second inner observer, provided the account distinguishes useful representation from denial of experience.

novelty.explanation: This removes the ambiguity surrounding user illusion and answers the regress of an inner user.

premises.text: Natural selection, learning, and culture can successively generate biological functions, individual goals, and socially assessable reasons even though elementary physical regularities have no purposes.

novelty.explanation: This supplies intermediate stages between selected function and conscious purpose.

premises.text: Moral practices can be constructed yet objectively improvable relative to facts about agency, suffering, cooperation, consistency, and the consequences of alternative institutional arrangements.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens the chess analogy with morally relevant constraints and standards of criticism.

premises.text: Responsibility can track reasons-responsive self-control, learning capacity, and freedom from coercive external management rather than identical-past alternatives or random physical variation.

novelty.explanation: This integrates the positive compatibilist criterion with the diagnostic objection to randomness.

conclusion.text: Therefore, naturalism can provisionally explain persons through empirically grounded realization and autonomous higher-level descriptions, while remaining answerable to unresolved questions about phenomenal character, normativity, and ownership of agency.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion preserves naturalistic confidence but explicitly limits it to a defeasible research position.

newArguments.title: Intervention convergence argument
newArguments.text: Naturalism gains support when independently targeted interventions converge on the same organized capacities. Changes to neural circuitry, development, learning environments, and social scaffolding can each alter memory continuity, purposive planning, moral sensitivity, and self-control in predictable ways. Convergence would be difficult to explain if the decisive personal properties belonged primarily to an independent subject whose relation to these interventions remained unspecified. The inference is defeasible, but it gives naturalism a comparative evidential advantage and identifies what an irreducibility theory must explain rather than relying solely on methodological optimism.

novelty.explanation: This is a new comparative inference from convergent interventions across several person-level capacities.

newArguments.title: Cross-level causal stability
newArguments.text: Higher-level properties earn realism when they support stable counterfactuals across many physical implementations. A promise, goal, belief, or autonomous policy can explain behavior even when its neural details vary, because changing the higher-level state would predictably change action across realizations. Naturalism can therefore preserve causal significance without requiring fundamental particles to contain promises or purposes. This answers the catalogue objection more directly than simple analogy: explanatory autonomy reflects robust organization and counterfactual structure, while metaphysical addition would require separate evidence beyond the usefulness of the higher-level description.

novelty.explanation: This develops the levels reply into a counterfactual criterion for genuine higher-level causal explanation.
